q: Olympique Lyonnais were founded in which year?
hint: The club emerged from the football section of an older multi-sport association and moved into the Stade de Gerland the same year.

q: How many Coupe de France titles have Lyon won?
hint: The first came in 1964 and the most recent in 2012, so they are outnumbered by the club's seven league titles.

q: Which club won the last Ligue 1 title before Lyon's run of seven began?
hint: They took the 2000-01 championship, and Lyon then won every title from 2001-02 onwards.
